The campus budget risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a stable and reusable logic implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the judge_reward of 0.73 suggests potential for optimization in output formatting or edge-case handling, the core logic is verified. Results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 5-minute runtime.
